llm_request: "Rewrite the following email for clarity and professionalism, ensuring it maintains the key points (gratitude, document submission, willingness to provide additional materials) while avoiding any personal details. Structure the response as a polished follow-up to a lender requesting a land loan. Do not include any private information in your response. Email text: 'Jason, Thank you for your patience. It has been a busy week with travel with the military for me and today was the first day I had the chance to catch my breath and catch up. As requested attached is mine and my wife's last two W-2s and the provided financial statement form. I provided both my wife and mine if necessary but if it is not needed please feel free to let me know and not utilize it. Thanks in advance an I look forward to working with you.'"
llm_response:
**Subject:** Follow-Up: Requested Documents for Land Loan Application

Dear [Lender's Name],

Thank you for your patience while I gathered the requested materials. I have been traveling recently and am just now catching up on my correspondence. 

As requested, please find attached the necessary documents to proceed with the land loan application, including the recent W-2s and the completed financial statement form. 

I have included all applicable financial documentation to ensure you have everything needed for the review. If any additional materials or further information are required, please let me know and I will be happy to provide them. 

Thank you in advance for your assistance. I look forward to working with you.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
